{"name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Playwright风格的Slate UI自动化工具集。

公开快照、屏幕截图和交互工具，用于以编程方式驱动
虚幻编辑器UI。通过UToolsetRegistry注册，
因此ModelContextProtocol插件会自动将其拾取。

浅根观察者（深度0）持续追踪顶层
窗口。在使用特定窗口或面板之前，在其上调用
Observe()以获取深度控件覆盖，完成后再调用
Unobserve()。观察者每~100ms遍历其子树，将引用分配给新出现的控件，并持续更新引用缓存。

输入模拟使用直接的Slate事件API（ProcessKeyCharEvent、
ProcessMouseButtonDownEvent等），而不是AutomationDriver，
因AutomationDriver 的同步AI在从
游戏线程（MCP工具调用执行所在的线程）调用时会发生死锁。","tools":[{"description":"列出、选择或关闭顶层Slate编辑器窗口。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Windows","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","description":"“list”返回JSON数组，“select”移到最前面，“close”销毁。","default":"list"},"index":{"type":"integer","default":-1}}},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"检查Slate控件树中是否存在文本。
非阻塞：检查一次，立即返回。等待的轮询。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.WaitFor","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"text":{"type":"string","description":"必须存在的文本（为空=跳过）。"},"textGone":{"type":"string","description":"必须缺少的文本（空 = 跳过）。"}},"required":["text","textGone"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"通过其标识符移除观察者。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Unobserve","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"identifier":{"type":"string"}},"required":["identifier"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"在Slate文本输入控件中输入文本。首先聚焦控件，
然后为每个字符发送一个键事件。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Type","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"ref":{"type":"string","description":"Slate文本框引用。"},"text":{"type":"string","description":"要输入的文本。"},"submit":{"type":"boolean","description":"输入后按Enter键。","default":false}},"required":["ref","text"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"捕获Slate UI可访问性快照。使用此项读取当前控件树，

并发现操作工具（点击、类型、悬停等）的引用。浅根观察者（深度0）自动覆盖顶层窗口。
在与特定窗口或面板交互之前，在其上调用Observe()以获得深度覆盖，
然后对该子树进行快照以查看其内容。
先前快照发现的引用仍然可用。你无需在每次操作
之前再次调用快照。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Snapshot","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"ref":{"type":"string","description":"子树根引用。空 = 所有窗口。"},"maxDepth":{"type":"integer","description":"最大深度（默认为30）。","default":30},"bIncludeSourceLocations":{"type":"boolean","description":"包含[src=File:Line]标签，显示每个控件在C++中的创建位置。","default":false}},"required":["ref"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"通过其文本标签在Slate组合框中选择一个选项。
打开下拉菜单，找到匹配的文本，然后点击它。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.SelectOption","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"ref":{"type":"string","description":"Slate组合框引用。"},"value":{"type":"string","description":"要选择的确切选项文本。"}},"required":["ref","value"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"截取Slate控件或激活编辑器窗口的截图。在编辑器UI中请优先使用此方法而非
SceneTools.take_screenshot；仅将SceneTools用于3D视口。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Screenshot","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"ref":{"type":"string","description":"Slate控件引用。空=激活窗口。"}},"required":["ref"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"title":"ToolsetImage","type":"object","properties":{"mimeType":{"type":"string","description":"图像的编码格式。"},"data":{"type":"string","description":"编码为base64字符串的图像数据。"}},"required":["mimeType","data"]}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"在当前聚焦的Slate控件上按下键盘键后再松开。
支持修改器前缀：“Ctrl+C”、“Shift+1”。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.PressKey","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"key":{"type":"string","description":"带可选修改器的键名，例如"Enter"、"Ctrl+A"、"Shift+Tab"。"}},"required":["key"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"在控件子树上注册一个观察器，以便持续更新其引用（~100ms tick）。在你即将使用的窗口或面板上
调用此项。它确保出现在该子树中
的新控件自动分配引用。完成后取消观测。
浅根观察者（深度0）已覆盖顶级窗口。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Observe","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"ref":{"type":"string","description":"要观测的根控件引用。空 = 所有可见窗口。"},"maxDepth":{"type":"integer","description":"从根开始遍历的最大深度。","default":30}},"required":["ref"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"将所有活跃的观察者列为JSON数组，用于调试。
每个条目都包含观察者标识符、是否为根观察者、
根控件引用（如果有）、最大深度和缓存快照大小。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.ListObservers","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"悬停在Slate控件上，触发任何悬停状态或提示文本。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Hover","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"ref":{"type":"string","description":"Slate控件引用。"}},"required":["ref"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"一次填写多个Slate表单字段。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.FillForm","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"fields":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"SlateInspectorToolsetFormField","type":"object","properties":{"ref":{"type":"string","description":"表单域控件的引用标识符。"},"value":{"type":"string","description":"要设置的值。"},"fieldType":{"type":"string","description":"域的类型：“文本框”、“复选框”或“组合框”。"}},"required":["ref","value","fieldType"]},"description":"{Ref, Value, FieldType}的数组，其中FieldType为 “文本框”、“复选框”或“组合框”。"}},"required":["fields"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"从一个Slate控件拖动到另一个（鼠标按下、移动、松开）。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Drag","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"startRef":{"type":"string","description":"用于拖动源的Slate控件引用。"},"endRef":{"type":"string","description":"用于放置目标的Slate控件引用。"},"modifiers":{"title":"SlateInspectorToolsetModifierKeys","description":"拖动期间按住的修改器键。","default":{"bShift":false,"bCtrl":false,"bAlt":false,"bCmd":false},"type":"object","properties":{"bShift":{"type":"boolean"},"bCtrl":{"type":"boolean"},"bAlt":{"type":"boolean"},"bCmd":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["bShift","bCtrl","bAlt","bCmd"]}},"required":["startRef","endRef"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}},{"description":"点击由其引用标识的Slate控件。","name":"SlateInspectorToolset.SlateInspectorToolset.Click","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"ref":{"type":"string","description":"Slate控件引用。"},"button":{"type":"string","description":"“左”、“右”或“中”。","default":"left"},"doubleClick":{"type":"boolean","description":"双击时为true。","default":false},"modifiers":{"title":"SlateInspectorToolsetModifierKeys","description":"点击期间按住的修改器键。","default":{"bShift":false,"bCtrl":false,"bAlt":false,"bCmd":false},"type":"object","properties":{"bShift":{"type":"boolean"},"bCtrl":{"type":"boolean"},"bAlt":{"type":"boolean"},"bCmd":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["bShift","bCtrl","bAlt","bCmd"]}},"required":["ref"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["returnValue"]}}]}
